messages:
jenny_csm: Morning — kicking off Day 0 onboarding for Mosaic Health. Goal: align stakeholders, define 30/60/90 success criteria, and set a handoff timeline. Owners, please add yourself and any immediate constraints. Start target: Mon Jun 2.

alex_se: I can own technical onboarding (API keys, test suite, integration checklist). I'll schedule an engineering onboarding call for Wed Jun 4.

maria_success: I'll lead enablement and training materials and the playbook. Need list of end-user roles + sample datasets to tailor examples.

sam_pmo: I'll track milestones + risks. Proposed milestones: 1) Access & env ready — Day 1; 2) Integrations smoke test — Day 3; 3) Feature pilot — Day 14; 4) Exec review + go/no-go — Day 21.

leo_cs_engineer: Will run a quick perf baseline once sandbox is up. Need SLA targets — is p50 <120ms acceptable for the generate endpoint?

jenny_csm: Tentative success criteria: a) 3 core user flows automated and validated; b) p50 latency <120ms for core gen; c) token cost within agreed budget (we'll quantify); d) stakeholder signoff on docs & runbook.

alex_se: For rollout: canary on Dedicated after pilot. Also flag: Mosaic requires EU data residency for PHI-adjacent data — VPC checklist required, ops to confirm.

maria_success: Training plan: two live 1-hr sessions (admin + developers) + recorded playbook and quickstart. I'll spin up a Confluence page and a short checklist.

ops_bot: @jenny_csm Provision request received for project "mosaic-sbx". Sandbox cluster ETA: 24h. Calendar invite created for Onboarding Kickoff — Jun 2 10:00 PT.

sam_pmo: Risk notes: renewal risk = medium if pilot slips >30 days. Mitigations: weekly status emails, exec sync at Day 7, contingency demo with fallback model if perf issues.

jenny_csm: Action items (quick): alex -> API & integration checklist by EOD Tue; maria -> draft playbook + training outline by Thu; sam -> milestone tracker + risk doc by Tue morning; leo -> perf script + baseline by Wed. Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept these.

alex_se: :thumbsup:

maria_success: :thumbsup:

leo_cs_engineer: I'll add the perf script to the repo and post the run instructions in the doc today.

jenny_csm: Thanks team — I'll publish the stakeholder roster and send the meeting invite. If folks want to add other stakeholders (legal, security), drop them here and I'll loop them in.
